acceptanceCriteria.description: The landing page loads without errors.
acceptanceCriteria.test: Navigate to the page and verify no console errors.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The hero section displays a colorful gradient background.
acceptanceCriteria.test: Check that the hero section has a gradient background with at least 3 colors.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The particle canvas is visible and interactive.
acceptanceCriteria.test: Move mouse over canvas and verify particles react.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Theme toggle switches between light and dark mode.
acceptanceCriteria.test: Click toggle and verify background and text colors change.
Resize browser to mobile width and verify layout adapts.
